head: 1d691a82851664989e767ae3b8ae129258464233
summary: Fixed the two accepted defects and nothing else. In the stand-in GitHub, the id-as-string and id-as-float switches now format the picked account's id (user.ID), not the one SetUser names. In the seeded launcher, run() now sets final.Fake = fake, so the returned Program names the stand-in its program signs in through. run()'s doc comment now says that SignIn, Owner and Approve do not sign anyone in against the picker, and that a caller follows the picker's link as screens_test's signInBy does. Both engine tests are in the tree as given. Each fails with its fix taken out and passes with it, and the full suite exits 0.

files.why: O-037: the UserIDString and UserIDFloat cases of userInfo format user.ID (the picked account when there is one) instead of f.user.ID.
O-038: run() sets final.Fake = fake after program.Start, and its doc comment says what the returned Program can and cannot do for sign-in.
O-038: the engine's TestRunReturnsTheStandInItsProgramUses, as given.

obligations.how: In userInfo the UserIDString and UserIDFloat cases now use user.ID, so a picked owner 4242 comes back as "4242" and as 4242.0 with login report-author. The test is at internal/testutil/fakegithub/picked_id_shape_test.go as given and passes under `go test -count=1 -run ^TestPickedUserKeepsItsIDUnderIDShapeSwitches$ ./internal/testutil/fakegithub/`. With the two lines put back to f.user.ID it fails, answering id "42" and 42.

run() sets final.Fake = fake right after program.Start, so p.Fake.URL() is the stand-in the serving program redirects sign-in to. The test is at internal/testutil/seeded/run_fake_test.go as given and passes under `go test -count=1 -run ^TestRunReturnsTheStandInItsProgramUses$ ./internal/testutil/seeded/`. With the line removed it fails: sign-in goes to :56202 while p.Fake is :56203. run()'s doc comment now says that SignIn, Owner and Approve do not sign anyone in against the picker, and that a caller signs in by following the picker's link as signInBy does.

tests.note: Runs the real launcher; the sign-in redirect starts with p.Fake.URL().

tests.command: the same two commands with each fix undone in an overlay copy under the temp folder (user.ID back to f.user.ID; the final.Fake line removed)
tests.note: These checks are meant to fail, and did. The first answered id "42" and 42 for the picked owner 4242. The second reported sign-in going to http://127.0.0.1:56202 while p.Fake named :56203. The repo files were not touched.

tests.command: go test -count=1 -p 4 ./... (CHROME_BIN set, TAAD3_HOME and HBAND_TEST_ARTIFACTS in scratch)
tests.note: Exit 0; every package ok, including internal/server, the seeded and fakegithub packages and all tests/acceptance packages. The only non-ok lines were the two [no test files] packages.

tests.command: gofmt -d on LF copies of the four Go files; go vet ./internal/testutil/...
tests.note: Clean. The files are CRLF in the working tree like the rest of the repo. Leftover hband-* temp folders were removed and no seeded or hband process remains.

follow_ups: The engine's projects.app_command still has to be repointed to `go run ./internal/testutil/seeded -port {port}`; the builder cannot write the ledger.
O-017 (Firefox and Safari) stays open as a known limit of this machine: only Chrome is driven here.
